affinity.notes: The design reads as a physical beast with no explicit elemental coating or magic effect.

anatomy.notes: The digitigrade legs, clawed arms, lupine head, and tail are coherent in motion.

archetype.notes: Perceived role "melee pouncer" semantically communicates Digitigrade Crosscut Specialist (Specialist) or its battlefield duty.

counterplay.notes: Raised claws, forward lean, and loaded rear leg clearly signal a leap or rush.

finish.notes: Fur, claws, torn cloth, and facial detail are polished without losing the silhouette.

framing.notes: The entire lunging silhouette fits comfortably and separates from the ruins.

identity.notes: Blind perception "werewolf or lycanthrope" semantically identifies werebeasts/werebeast-werebeast.

tier.notes: Perceived tier "elite" is accepted for intended T3 under the documented v2 normalization.
